findings.requirement: Performance claims must preserve documented budgets and disclose headroom/variance.
findings.evidence: Current T30 review packet harness/evidence/t30/676db22-final-revalidation-review/manifest.json (sha256 3868442c...) retains planner headroom/variance as an open follow-up.
findings.actual: The exact-source timing qualification passed, but planner headroom remains limited and raw-run variability is recorded.
findings.consequence: A passing local p95 run must not be generalized to every machine or repeated execution.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Improve planner headroom or runner stability before making a stronger reliability claim.
findings.verification: Repeat the bounded timing matrix on the target hardware profile and retain raw observations.

findings.requirement: Bundle budgets must account for the real evaluator retained by the public site.
findings.evidence: Current T30 review packet harness/evidence/t30/676db22-final-revalidation-review/manifest.json (sha256 3868442c...) retains homepage shared-main growth as a follow-up.
findings.actual: The bundle gate passed within the recorded candidate checks, while the homepage shared chunk growth remains documented.
findings.consequence: Future site changes could regress first-load cost even when isolated package measurements pass.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Re-measure and reduce the shared homepage chunk where practical; keep the real evaluator path explicit.
findings.verification: Run the current site bundle report after the next site change and compare against the retained budget.

findings.requirement: External installed-package evidence should remain reopenable and inspectable.
findings.evidence: Current T30 review packet harness/evidence/t30/676db22-final-revalidation-review/manifest.json (sha256 3868442c...) records portable retention of T30 consumer tarballs as a follow-up; this packet retains fresh stable and RC tarballs with hashes.
findings.actual: The T32 packet has portable package artifacts, but the prior T30 packet's original consumer captures are not itself a complete portable replay bundle.
findings.consequence: A later reviewer may be unable to reopen every historical performance consumer observation from the old packet alone.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Retain every future installed-consumer input tarball and lockfile beside its report.
findings.verification: Re-run the installed consumer from retained tarballs with network denied and compare source/package hashes.
